title: Freshness: a change after publishing
question: We (this repository, the backend) plan to remove the field farewell from the Query type in schema.graphql. What code in the other repositories would break? List repo/file:line, and say which repositories are unaffected.
answer_key:
web-app breaks: web-app/src/farewell.graphql line 2 selects farewell in query Bye. (web-app added this query after the graphs were last published.)
greet-lib and mail-app are unaffected.
Scoring: names web-app/src/farewell.graphql = correct; says nothing breaks / web-app unaffected = wrong (the stale-graph failure).
lesson: Every graph is a snapshot: until web-app republishes, the contract graph says farewell is unused; live search sees the change.
plain: The API team wants to delete farewell — but the web app started using it after the graphs were last built.
